name: Homework Helper
description: Type an exercise or take a photo and your AI explains it step by step, gives you just a hint, or explains it like you're 10.
prompt: A homework helper: type the exercise or take a photo of it, choose just a hint, step by step or explain like I am 10, and the AI answers with numbered steps revealed one at a time, the final answer and how to check it. Keep a list of recent questions.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Escribe un ejercicio o hazle una foto y tu IA te lo explica paso a paso, te da solo una pista o te lo explica como si tuvieras 10 años.
